title: PM Kisan Samman Nidhi
summary: Direct income support of ₹6,000 per year in three equal installments to all landholding farmer families across India to help purchase inputs.
source: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

title: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
summary: Financial support and risk coverage for farmers suffering crop loss or damage due to natural calamities, pests, and diseases.
benefit: Low Premium Crop Insurance (1.5% - 2% Premium for Rabi/Kharif crops)
source: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
documents: Sowing Certificate issued by Patwari/Gram Panchayat

title: PM KUSUM Yojana (Solar Pumps)
summary: De-dieselization of the farm sector. Install clean solar water pumps with 60% combined subsidy from Central & State Governments.
benefit: 60% Subsidy on Solar Water Pump Installation
source: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy

title: Soil Health Card Scheme
summary: Provides soil testing services to help farmers understand the nutrient status of their soil and receive recommendations on fertilizer dosage.
benefit: Free Soil Health Testing & Advisory Card
source: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

title: Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana (PKVY)
summary: Supports organic farming in clusters. Financial assistance of ₹50,000 per hectare for 3 years is provided for organic inputs, certification, and packaging.
benefit: ₹50,000 / Hectare Subsidy for organic cultivation and certification

title: Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization (SMAM)
summary: Assistance for procurement of modern agricultural machinery (tractors, tillers, harvesters, rotavators) to reduce labor costs and increase efficiency.
benefit: 40% to 50% Subsidy on Agricultural Equipment (up to 80% for SC/ST/Women/Small farmers)

title: Per Drop More Crop (PDMC - PMKSY)
summary: Promotes micro-irrigation systems like drip and sprinkler setups to enhance water-use efficiency and crop productivity.
benefit: 45% to 55% Subsidy on Drip and Sprinkler Irrigation Systems
source: Department of Agriculture, Cooperation & Farmers Welfare

title: Rythu Bandhu Scheme (Telangana)
summary: Investment support scheme of the Telangana Government providing direct cash assistance to farmers for purchase of seeds, fertilizers, and pesticide inputs.
benefit: ₹10,000 / Acre / Year investment support in two crop seasons
documents: Bank Account details linked with Aadhaar
